label: Strict-ground support bundle has a populated model with a dependence edge
paraphrase: Mathematical nonvacuity witness: over the natural numbers, one consistent PLG theory (Fine infinite descent, deriving n+1 ≺ n), the identity labelling and the relation D x y iff y = x + 1 jointly satisfy PLG consistency and the dependence-to-strict-ground map, and D has a distinct edge (0 to 1). A formal interpretation only; it says nothing about which beings or existence facts there are.
